$comment: Cloud Firestore schema — CheraSakhi. Months are 'yyyy-MM' strings. Money is a number in the group currency. Phones are E.164. Text/structured data only; no Storage uploads.

users/{uid}.name: string
users/{uid}.loginAlias: string — internal Email/Password alias derived from phone
users/{uid}.isKuriMember: bool — Kuri cohort access (missing on old profiles ⇒ memberId != null)

members/{memberId}.name: string
members/{memberId}.phone: string (E.164, must equal the Phone-Auth number)

contributions/{id}.holderId: string (member who physically received the cash)

expenses/{id}.splitCount: int — informational only; the engine always splits across CURRENT active participants
expenses/{id}.createdBy: uid — admin, or the participant who logged it (may delete it)

participants/{participantId}.$comment: Trip roster for the auto-split. id = Kuri member id | community id | 'guest_<auto>'
participants/{participantId}.name: string
participants/{participantId}.active: bool — only active participants share the cost
participants/{participantId}.joinedAt: timestamp (join order decides who absorbs leftover paise)

derived.cashHolderBalance: contributions received + transfers in − expenses paid − transfers out (computed client-side in EventLedger.compute)
derived.quizWinner: Fastest Finger First: among submissions in [startTime, endTime) whose normalized answer is accepted, earliest submittedAt wins (tie → lowest userId). Same code on phones (Dart) and server (functions/quiz_logic.js).
derived.autoSplit: perPerson = Σ bills ÷ active participants (integer paise, remainder to earliest joiners). paidUpfront = bills paid + contributions given − pool cash received + handovers given − handovers received. net = paidUpfront − share (>0 gets back, <0 owes). Recomputed from raw entries on every change.

community/{personId}.$comment: General text roster for event participants
community/{personId}.name: string

invitations/{token}.$comment: Admin-created one-time member invite; direct token read is allowed only while pending and unexpired
invitations/{token}.name: string

quizzes/{quizId}.$comment: Live quiz — readable by every member. No question text and no answer here.
quizzes/{quizId}.title: string

submissions/{uid}.$rules: create-only, startTime ≤ request.time < endTime, not admins
